question: Related Questions Q. Please help us to find the right way in our life. I am a software engineer working for a software company. The focus of our software company is banking field and most of the clients are banks. The problem I am facing now is that the project that I am working is for banking software and the bank that I am working is not Islamic bank. The software that I develop or involved is used by the Bank to open account on-line through internet,applying on-line application for credit card, to view the Interest rates on internet for checking account, saving account and fixed deposits, etc.. I ask you to guide me whether doing work for a bank is haram (unlawful) even though I am not directly working for the bank and salary is given by my company, not the Bank. 2274 views Q. My question is why dont the muslim ulema from prestigious institutions like yours talk to these banks / govt and see to it that islamic way of getting money is made available, see no muslim wants to deal in interest if we have another choice, it is easy for you people to sit and send fatwas that this is haram and that is haram, but what is the alternative, if you dont come up with something then people are forcefully going ahead with haram means. you must be well aware that a majority of the ummath is involved in riba..dont you think we all are responsible for this ??All the banks state that it is the RBI ruling that interest has to be charged, how is this when we have a populationnearing 25%?? Please let me know whether I can pay this bribe from haram money e.g. bank interest or there is any other way to do it. 2194 views Q. My questions are as below Q1. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 160545 Country: India Title: Taking bank loan Question: My father is a farmer. They have to marry me. My job is also 20000 rupees. Can we take have some loan from agricultural card? Answer ID: 160545 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 835/778/M=7/1439) When your salary is twenty thousand then why do you need to take bank loan? If you have to pay interest in case you take loan on this agricultural card then it shall not be lawful for you to take the loan and if you don’t have to pay interest then it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
